title: Run multi-view visual and temporal QA
description: A reversible, evidence-producing workflow for run multi-view visual and temporal qa.

ordered_stages.action: Lock references, views, camera, lighting, resolution, and tolerances.
Capture deterministic stills and temporal samples across the matrix.
Run format-aware metrics without treating any single score as authoritative.
Inspect silhouette, palette, identity, artifacts, motion, and gameplay readability.
Store annotated comparisons and request a human accept, revise, or reject decision.

quality_gates.description: Verify rights, consent, code, weights, datasets, output terms, and generation provenance.
Validate formats and domain-specific technical constraints.
Check visual identity and temporal consistency across relevant views and frames.
Check memory, frame time, draw calls, load time, and asset budgets.
Run interaction and playability smoke tests in the target runtime.
Store screenshots, artifacts, logs, versions, and comparison evidence.
Require human approval before replacing any source or production asset.
Multiple gameplay-relevant views and temporal samples are reviewed.
Automated metrics are corroborated by artifact evidence and human review.

fallbacks: Use deterministic screenshot diffs when learned metrics are unavailable.
Escalate ambiguous changes to side-by-side human review.
